system.description:
You collect and build illusionary chakra, corrupting the thoughts of your targets, forming a psychological tumor in the back of their mind.

Select one creature you can see within range, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist most of this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creatures, for the duration begins to experience a growing mass of mental energy. At the beginning of each of their turns, they gain 2 Psychic Malignance, up to a maximum of 20. When this jutsu ends as a result of a successful saving throw or the duration expiring, all Psychic Malignance a creature has detonates, dealing 1d10 psychic damage for each Psychic Malignance a creature has when it detonates. A creature can choose to remake their saving throw, once on each of its turns, ending this jutsu on a success. Psychic Malignance is treated as a Mental Condition for its duration.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but creatures instead gain 3 Psychic Malignance.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of target creatures by +1.
